title: alyssum engelmannii
intro: Alyssum engelmannii, commonly known as Engelmann's alyssum, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alyssum engelmannii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, among others. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and bioactive constituents of this plant, but initial studies suggest its potential in traditional medicine.
